name: zcode-plugin-workspace
description: Personal zcode desktop plugin marketplace: one plugin per top-level directory, shared libs in shared/, unified docs in docs/. Authoritative on the main branch; on feature branches a referenced plugin directory may not exist yet.

plugins.name: z-subagent-workflow
plugins.description: Subagent orchestration + deterministic multi-phase workflows for zcode via the zsw CLI (pure local one-shot processes since 2.0.0 — no resident daemon): subagent lifecycle with worktree isolation, schema outputs, model routing and four-root agent .md discovery, plus built-in workflows (chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop) and custom core-contract scripts referenced by absolute .js path. Long tasks are carried by Bash run_in_background (completion rides engine-native task-notification), no polling.

description_i18n.en: Subagent orchestration + deterministic multi-phase workflows for zcode via the zsw CLI (pure local one-shot processes since 2.0.0 — no resident daemon): subagent lifecycle with worktree isolation, schema outputs, model routing and four-root agent .md discovery, plus built-in workflows (chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop) and custom core-contract scripts referenced by absolute .js path. Long tasks are carried by Bash run_in_background (completion rides engine-native task-notification), no polling.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的 subagent 编排与确定性多阶段 workflow，统一走 zsw CLI（2.0.0 起纯本地一次性执行，无常驻 daemon）：subagent 生命周期管理（worktree 隔离、schema 结构化输出、模型路由、四根 agent .md 发现）+ 内置 workflow（chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop）与自定义 core 契约脚本扩展（按 .js 绝对路径引用）。长任务由 Bash run_in_background 承载（完成唤醒借引擎原生 task-notification），零轮询。

plugins.name: z-tool-finder
plugins.description: Progressive (lazy) loading for MCP tools in zcode: per-server proxy wrappers expose only get_tool_details/call_tool meta tools, a SessionStart hook auto-takes-over user/plugin stdio servers and injects an <available-custom-tools> manifest, and a global search_tools server indexes the catalog. Fully reversible via tf restore.

description_i18n.en: Progressive (lazy) loading for MCP tools in zcode: per-server proxy wrappers expose only get_tool_details/call_tool meta tools, a SessionStart hook auto-takes-over user/plugin stdio servers and injects an <available-custom-tools> manifest, and a global search_tools server indexes the catalog. Fully reversible via tf restore.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的 MCP 工具渐进式加载：per-server 代理 wrapper 只暴露 get_tool_details/call_tool 两个 meta 工具，SessionStart hook 自动接管用户级/插件级 stdio server 并注入 <available-custom-tools> 工具清单，全局 search_tools 检索 catalog。tf restore 一键还原。
